title: MultiTour - Real-Time Multiplayer Museum Simulation Game
summary: A multiplayer virtual tour simulation built in Unity utilizing custom backend database synchronization to mimic real-time multiplayer networking frameworks like Photon.
description:
Developed a multi-user virtual museum tour simulation in Unity, engineering a custom networking and synchronization architecture without relying on traditional real-time multiplayer SDKs like Photon.

Key Features & Architecture:
• Custom State Synchronization: Implemented a database-driven server architecture where player movements, positions, and tour states are continuously sent and fetched via REST APIs to achieve synchronized multiplayer behavior.
• Guide & Follower Modes: Designed dual-role mechanics allowing a player to act as a "Tour Guide" while others track movements and follow coordinate updates in real-time.
• UI & Session Management: Built interactive welcome screens, name inputs, and multi-display / dual-screen simulation setups for testing peer coordination.
• Tools & Technologies: Unity, C#, RESTful APIs, Backend Database Synchronization, Custom Networking Logic, UI Toolkit.

title: Mazraaty - 3D Farming Simulation Game
summary: An interactive 3D farming simulation game built in Unity featuring a custom spatial grid system and full-stack RESTful API backend synchronization.
description:
Developed a feature-rich 3D farming simulation game in Unity featuring seamless frontend-backend communication, real-time data persistence, and precise spatial land management.

Key Features & Architecture:
• Dynamic Grid System: Engineered a custom grid-based land partitioning system allowing players to dynamically plow empty plots, select coordinate-based tiles, plant various crops (carrots, wheat, tomatoes), and manage farm layouts.
• Backend & API Integration: Integrated RESTful APIs to handle user authentication (Sign In/Sign Up), real-time game state synchronization, and profile management.
• Database Persistence: Connected a backend database to securely store and retrieve player inventory, crop growth progress, virtual currency, and XP levels across sessions.
• Gameplay Mechanics: Implemented crop growth timers, leveling systems, item/pesticide usage affecting yield, and dynamic UI panels.

title: AR Planets - Augmented Reality Astronomy Education Application
summary: An immersive Augmented Reality educational application built in Unity to transform astronomy learning through interactive 3D solar system models and gamified quizzes.
description:
Developed an immersive Augmented Reality educational application built in Unity, designed to transform astronomy learning through interactive 3D solar system models and gamified quizzes.

Key Features & Architecture:
• Augmented Reality Tracking: Implemented image-tracking AR mechanics allowing users to project 3D interactive celestial bodies (Earth, Moon, Sun) directly onto physical reference markers.
• Interactive 3D Visualizations & UI: Engineered dynamic scale animations, detailed informational panels, and spatial UI elements displaying scientific facts (diameter, mass, distance from Earth).
• Gamified Quizzes: Integrated interactive multi-stage quizzes with real-time feedback loops to test user knowledge and reinforce learning outcomes.
• Tools & Technologies: Unity, C#, AR Foundation / AR Core, 3D Spatial UI, Interactive Animation Systems.

title: Night at the Museum - Virtual Reality Educational Experience
summary: An immersive Virtual Reality educational museum simulation built in Unity to enhance student engagement through interactive spatial navigation and multimedia exhibits.
description:
Developed an immersive Virtual Reality (VR) educational museum experience in Unity, designed to enhance student engagement and knowledge retention through interactive virtual environments.

Key Features & Architecture:
• Immersive VR Navigation: Implemented a waypoint-based navigation system allowing users to smoothly teleport and explore a virtual museum gallery.
• Interactive Multimedia Exhibits: Integrated interactive triggers allowing users to play spatial audio narrations, inspect anatomical models, and watch embedded video displays within the virtual space.
• Game-Based Learning Principles: Engineered the experience to leverage virtual reality immersion, boosting motivation and active participation in educational contexts.
• Tools & Technologies: Unity, C#, VR SDK, Spatial Audio, Interactive UI Systems.

title: Interactive AR Assembly Guide - Augmented Reality Product Manual
summary: An interactive Augmented Reality product assembly guide built in Unity and Vuforia, visualizing step-by-step mechanical parts assembly in 3D space.
description:
Developed an interactive Augmented Reality (AR) product assembly and user manual application in Unity, utilizing image-tracking mechanics to guide users through physical assembly processes in real-time.

Key Features & Architecture:
• AR Image Tracking & Marker Detection: Integrated Vuforia AR SDK to track markers and accurately anchor 3D components onto physical surfaces.
• Step-by-Step Assembly Animation: Engineered interactive sequential steps (e.g., preparing legs, showing surfaces, assembling parts) with smooth visual animations.
• Interactive UI Panels: Designed intuitive UI controllers to switch between assembly stages, control workflows, and monitor progress.
• Tools & Technologies: Unity, C#, Vuforia AR SDK, 3D Animation Systems, Spatial UI Toolkit.

title: AR Multi-Image Tracking & Proximity Interaction
summary: An advanced Augmented Reality project built in Unity and EasyAR featuring simultaneous multi-image tracking and dynamic 3D character anchoring based on physical target proximity.
description:
Developed an advanced Augmented Reality (AR) prototype in Unity utilizing the EasyAR SDK to implement simultaneous multi-image tracking and spatial anchoring.

Key Features & Architecture:
• Multi-Target Image Tracking: Configured multiple independent image markers to accurately detect and track physical cards in real-time under a single camera view.
• Dynamic 3D Character Anchoring: Programmed spatial logic to instantiate and anchor 3D characters (such as animated models) dynamically onto recognized image targets.
• Proximity & Interaction Handling: Engineered detection states that track the relative positions of physical markers to trigger specific in-game events or character positioning shifts.
• Tools & Technologies: Unity, C#, EasyAR SDK, Augmented Reality, Spatial Tracking, 3D Asset Management.

title: Trivia Snakes & Ladders - Interactive Educational Board Game
summary: An interactive digital Snakes & Ladders board game built in Unity, combining traditional gameplay with educational trivia quizzes and multi-player modes.
description:
Developed an interactive educational board game in Unity fusing the classic Snakes & Ladders mechanics with trivia quizzes to test and reinforce knowledge during gameplay.

Key Features & Architecture:
• Board Grid System & Movement: Programmed a coordinate-based grid map with smooth token traversal, handling ladders, snakes, and dice roll mechanics.
• Interactive Quiz Integration: Engineered popup trivia challenge systems that trigger during player progression, requiring correct answers to advance.
• Game Modes: Implemented both Single-Player and Multi-Player interface options for engaging local matches.
• Tools & Technologies: Unity, C#, UI Canvas & Toolkit, Game State Management, Interactive Board Logic.
